s1.syndrome_frame: Acute abdominal condition with signs of peritonitis and sepsis following intestinal surgery
salient_findings: Total abdominal tenderness with rebound pain and muscle tension
Intestinal perforation and peritonitis on CT scan
key_facts: 29-year-old Chinese male patient
No underlying disease
Hospitalized twice for injuries from a car accident
Initial admission for open abdominal injury
Emergency surgery and discharge after 5 days
Re-admitted due to persistent lower abdominal pain
Underwent emergency surgery for intestinal issues
Temperature rose to 39.3°C post-surgery
WBC 16.62 x109/L and neutrophils 87.80% on second admission
WBC 22.68 x109/L and neutrophils 94.1% post-surgery
CT scan showed intestinal perforation, peritonitis, and thickening of ascending colon and ileum segments
Blood culture positive in bilateral anaerobic bottles
Gram stain showed Gram-negative bacteria
Culture showed slow-growing, moist, gray-white colonies after 3 days
